question: A man riding on a bicycle at a speed of 24 km/hr crosses a bridge in 3.1 minutes. Find the length of the bridge.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed in km/min = 24 ÷ 60 = 0.4 km/min

Distance = Speed × Time

Distance = 0.4 × 3.1 = 1.24 km

**∴ The correct answer is 1.24 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the bicycle = 24 km/hr

Time taken to cross the bridge = 3.1 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

1 hour = 60 minutes

 Speed = 24 km/hr
 Time = 3.1 min

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, convert the time from minutes to hours to match the speed unit.

⇒ Time = 3.1 ÷ 60 hours

⇒ Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = 24 × (3.1 ÷ 60)

⇒ Distance = (24 ÷ 60) × 3.1

⇒ Distance = 0.4 × 3.1

⇒ Distance = 1.24 km

**∴ The correct answer is 1.24 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversions

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5 ÷ 18. To convert from m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance Covered ÷ Total Time Taken.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|. When moving in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.
